History with deleted logs will be lost. Forks whose parent rollout is missing will be deferred.

metrics.label: Metrics
metrics.realTotalHelp: Fresh input + output + cache writes + cache hits. Fresh input excludes cache; some protocols (such as OpenAI) don't report cache writes, so that part may be low.
metrics.hitRateHelpTitle: How the cache hit rate is calculated
metrics.hitRateHelp: Cache hits ÷ (fresh input + cache writes + cache hits).

heatmap.title: Usage heatmap
heatmap.subtitle: Daily usage over the last 53 weeks

usage.speedHelp: Output tokens per second, estimated from session-log timestamps (marked ≈). The logs have no first-token timing, so the wait for the first token is included and the number reads a little low. Only requests with at least 200 output tokens are estimated. Requests imported from CC Switch routing have exact timing.
usage.estimatedTimingTip: About {{duration}}s (estimated from session-log timestamps, including the wait for the first token)

detail.speedTooFew: Under 100 output tokens, so no speed
detail.speedEstimateTooFew: Under 200 output tokens, so no estimate
detail.noTimingSession: Session logs have no timing data
detail.noFirstToken: No first-token timing, so no speed

sources.scanHelp: The conversation records Claude Code and Codex write on this computer. Pigger Switch reads token usage from them; no proxy or API key is needed.
sources.cadenceOn: Scans once at startup, then every 60 seconds
sources.cadenceOff: Auto scan is off; logs are scanned only when you click Sync Now
sources.codexHelpTitle: What does Codex usage maintenance do?
sources.dirsHelp: Claude Code writes its sessions under projects/ in its config folder, Codex under sessions/. Change the folders in Settings if you moved them (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / CODEX_HOME are honoured too).

empty.title: No usage data yet

pricing.modelsDevHelp: Fetches the latest prices for the selected models at startup, at most every 6 hours; common models can be included automatically.
pricing.costHelp: Each request is priced by its model: fresh input, output, cache hits and cache writes are each multiplied by their unit price and added up.

usage.sessionsHint: Last 30 days · by cost · click a session for its requests

limits.noWindows: No rate-limit windows were returned for this plan.

notSignedIn.claude: Not signed in to Claude Code with a Claude subscription. Run claude and sign in with your Pro or Max account to see plan limits.
notSignedIn.codex: Codex is not signed in with ChatGPT (an API key has no plan limits). Run codex login to see plan limits.

expired.claude: The Claude Code login has expired. Run claude once to refresh it.
expired.codex: The Codex login has expired. Run codex once (or codex login) to refresh it.

limits.parseError: Could not read the login file: {{error}}
limits.alertOn: You get a desktop notification when any window reaches {{percent}}%.
limits.alertOff: Turn on alerts to get a desktop notification before you hit a limit. Limits refresh every 5 minutes in the background.

intro.claude: How much of your Claude plan (Pro / Max) each rate-limit window has used, and what that comes to in dollars and tokens. Read from Claude Code's login on this computer; nothing is changed.
intro.codex: How much of your ChatGPT plan's Codex limits each window has used, and what that comes to in dollars and tokens. Read from Codex's login on this computer; nothing is changed.

estimateNote.claude: Limits are estimates. The plan only reports a percentage, so the limit is this computer's Claude Code usage in the window (at API prices) divided by that percentage. Use on claude.ai or other computers counts toward the same limit but not here, which makes the estimate low.
estimateNote.codex: Limits are estimates. The plan only reports a percentage, so the limit is this computer's Codex usage in the window (at API prices) divided by that percentage. Codex used elsewhere (other computers, Codex cloud tasks) counts toward the same limit but not here, which makes the estimate low.

window.noEstimate: Not enough usage in this window yet to estimate its limit
window.noResetTime: The plan gave no reset time for this window, so it can't be measured
window.usedUp: Probably used up until the reset
window.runsOutAt: At this pace it runs out around {{time}}
window.projected: At this pace: about {{value}}% by the reset
window.perFiveHour_one: ≈ {{cost}} · {{tokens}} tokens for the last 5 hours before the reset
window.perFiveHour_other: ≈ {{cost}} · {{tokens}} tokens per 5 hours for the {{count}} left
window.usedElsewhere: Used elsewhere (no requests on this computer), so no estimate

history.title: Past windows
history.empty: No windows yet. They appear as you use the tool.
history.inferredHint: No plan reading for this window: its start is inferred from your first request in it
history.shareEstimated: No reading for this window: measured against the typical limit
history.footnote: Used is the highest percentage the plan reported in each window. ≈ means no reading for that window: its cost compared with the typical limit, which passes 100% if the limit was different then (another plan). * Start inferred from the first request.

prices.help: One price table for both tools. Every cost in the app is what the tokens would cost at these API prices. Prices can sync from models.dev.
